desc:
🦖 Dinomaster Card Game [Fan-Made]

A Dinomaster card game on Roblox with two modes: Classic (Series 1, 2 and 2.5) and DBWC 6.3 (adds the New Master cards).

✨ Features
- Card shop: claim a starter deck, buy decks, and open random booster packs
- Classic: build a 30-card deck
- DBWC: build a 40-60 card deck with a Master, Red Zone and Commander
- Ranked: press RANKED and FIND MATCH to climb the ladder
- PvP play tables (pick the mode when you sit) and the Bot Arcade with 10 cabinets
- Win matches to earn coins for decks and booster packs
- Effects, sound, music, and a turn timer

📚 Data source [DINOMASTER CLUB]
Card data and rules are based on the DINOMASTER CLUB website.

📌 Note
Fan-made project, not affiliated with or endorsed by the original owners. All rights to the game, cards, and artwork belong to them.

Work in progress, so you may run into some bugs. Thanks for playing! 🙏
